{{Quote|Best post exchange around. You need it we got it.|Jevek describes his stall|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Jevek''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] who served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Army|army]] as a [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the war he was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] where worked as a heavy [[Armor/Legends|armor]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] and ran a stall within the Republic controlled [[Shipwright Auxiliary Spaceport]]. Jevek had [[Color/Legends|brown]] hair and skin and yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. While at his stall he wore white armor with blue markings.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Corporal Jevek appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Heavy Armor Vendor for Republic players on Corellia.<ref name="TOR" /> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> Jevek was removed from the game along with the rest of the Heavy Armor Vendors.<ref name="TOR" /> His position is also marked on a map in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'', a game guide released by [[Prima Games]].<ref name="Explorer">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref>
